sources.supports: Android: 'Touch and hold a message'; 'tap the box at the top left, next to "Select all"'; 'By default, Gmail selects up to 50 messages to delete'; to select 50 more, scroll to the top and tap Select all again; tap Delete at the top; 'Touch and hold each message you want to delete'; search operators for specific emails.
sources.review_notes: Fetched 2026-10-23 by the drafting agent through a summarising fetch tool. Quotes above were returned verbatim; step order paraphrased. Page shows no last-updated date.

sources.supports: iPhone/iPad: 'Touch and hold a message'; box next to 'Select all' at top left; up to 50 messages by default; scroll back to the top and tap Select all again for 50 more; 'At the top, tap Delete'.
sources.review_notes: Fetched 2026-10-23. Matches the Android page for selection; used for the both-platforms claim and the Delete row.

sources.supports: Android mark multiple as read: 'On the left of the message, tap the sender's profile image'; 'At the top left, tap the box next to "Select all."'; tip 'To select more messages, scroll down, then tap the box next to "Select all" again'; 'At the top right, tap Mark as read'.
sources.review_notes: Fetched 2026-10-23. This page documents the profile-image gesture and does not mention touch-and-hold. Its 'scroll down' tip differs from the deletion page's 'scroll to the top'; the draft reports that inconsistency and tells readers to rely on the selected count rather than choosing one.

sources.supports: iPhone/iPad mark multiple as read: same four steps as Android (sender's profile image, Select all box, 'scroll down' tip, Mark as read top right).
sources.review_notes: Fetched 2026-10-23. Supports the profile-image row as applying to both platforms.

serp_review.query: how to select multiple emails in the gmail mobile app
serp_review.observation: Results: getmailbird.com, streak.com (two URLs), androidauthority.com, blog.incogni.com (several URLs), thestatesman.com news item on an Android 'Select all' (50) rollout, kobedigital.com. Snippets agree on press-and-hold then tap others; they conflict on whether the app has Select all at all. None reconciled Google's own two documented entry gestures or tabulated post-selection actions by platform.
serp_review.limitation: One standard US web search; result pages weren't opened, so the characterisation rests on titles and snippets.

information_gain: A cross-platform (Android + iPhone/iPad) selection guide whose job is selecting for any action, not deleting: it reconciles Google's two documented ways into selection mode (touch-and-hold on the delete/archive/label pages vs tapping the sender's profile image on the mark-as-read pages), flags Google's own inconsistent 'scroll to the top' vs 'scroll down' tip for adding the next 50, and gives a platform-by-platform action table (Delete, Archive, Mark as read, Label as vs Labels, Move to vs Change labels with OK vs Done) sourced from six device-specific help pages. The hub how-to-select-all-emails-gmail is desktop-focused and only carries a one-sentence Android aside.
overlap_check: Material overlap exists with the unpublished pending drafts how-to-bulk-delete-emails-gmail-iphone and how-to-bulk-delete-emails-gmail-android, which both include touch-and-hold + Select all + 50-message steps as the first part of a deletion procedure. This draft deliberately does not repeat their deletion rounds table, Trash/swipe/restore paths or delete-all decision table, and focuses on selection mechanics and non-delete actions (archive, mark read, label, move). It does not link to those drafts because they are unpublished. A reviewer should decide whether this selection page and the two device delete pages should all stay separate; if they are kept, they should cross-link once published. Pending topics gmail-select-all-greyed-out, gmail-selected-emails-count-wrong and gmail-select-all-conversations-desktop-site-mobile are adjacent; this draft makes no claims about desktop-site mode on phones or greyed-out controls.
limitations: Source and documentation review only; no live Android or iOS device or Gmail mailbox test, and no original screenshots.
The fetch tool summarised pages; exact UI labels should be confirmed on the live help pages or a current app build.

That tapping additional emails (rather than touching and holding each) adds them once in selection mode is not stated in Google's help; the draft instead follows Google's 'touch and hold each' wording.
Absence of an all-matching selection in the app is stated only as not described in Google's help, not as tested absence.
Whether 'Select all' counts messages or conversations in conversation view isn't documented; the draft uses Google's word 'messages'.
Apple Mail, Samsung Email and other mail apps weren't reviewed.
SERP review relied on result titles/snippets, not opened pages.
